name: HorineTech Keynote

actions.name: Next
actions.description: Advance the slideshow (next build or slide)

actions.name: Refresh state
actions.description: Ask the app to resend the current slide state

feedbacks.name: Current slide has label
feedbacks.description: True while the slide on screen carries this [LABEL] in its notes

feedbacks.name: Label fired
feedbacks.description: True for a moment after the app fires this label. Use it as a Trigger condition to run actions when a slide with the label is shown. Leave the label empty to match any label.

notes: Complete list: 8 actions (src/actions.ts UpdateActions) and 5 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts UpdateFeedbacks). Variables (src/variables.ts) and presets (src/presets.ts) are not catalogued.

Third-party module (not in the bitfocus organization). It does not talk to Keynote directly: it is a line-based JSON TCP client (net.createConnection, src/client.ts:99) to the separate "Keynote Companion" Mac menu-bar app, default port 7878 (src/protocol.ts), optional shared token (config field token). Commands are { cmd: next|previous|first|last|goto|start|stop|refresh }; the app sends state, trigger, heartbeat and error lines. The Mac app was not inspected.

Built on @companion-module/base ~2.1.3: option values can be expressions. The source says slide numbers may arrive as strings when they come from an expression and converts them with toSlideNumber (src/actions.ts:18-21): only whole numbers >= 1 are sent, otherwise the action logs a warning (goto) or does nothing (start from "slide").
package.json says 0.1.1 while companion/manifest.json still says version 0.0.0.

start: the slide option is only shown when from is "slide" (isVisibleExpression). Any other value of "from" than "current" or "slide" is sent as "beginning" (src/actions.ts:100). label_fired: leave the label empty to match any label; hold is capped at MAX_HOLD_SECONDS = 60 (src/feedbacks.ts:18). Feedback colours are not catalogued (defaultStyle).
The max of 10000 on the slide number options is the module limit, not a Keynote limit.
